title: 第13章 她就值一万块第14章 误会这就来了
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落收了乾坤袋出了摘星宗，来到云隐镇，买了几个肉包子充饥，又买了一张黑雾森林的地图。
此时街道上熙熙攘攘，不少人聚集在一起，几乎都是散修。
看见云星落，一名带着棕色双角帽的中年男子走了过来，“道友，可要乘坐飞舟？”
“还可以乘飞舟吗？”
云星落第一次单独出门，并不知道这一点。
“当然，我们的飞舟能到黑雾森林的各个小镇，这一次我们飞往寻仙镇，道友可要去？”
“多少钱？”
“一千块下品灵石，想走就快点上去，我们一天只跑一个来回。”
一千块，有些小贵，但黑雾森林这种地方，御剑很是危险，随时会被天上的猛兽攻击，所以很多人选择了坐飞舟。
大宗门都有自己的飞舟，散修没有，所以就有不少人在黑雾森林做飞舟运输的生意。
云星落爽快地掏了一千块灵石，上了飞舟。
从云隐镇坐飞舟到寻仙镇并不远，不过半个时辰就到了。
此时的寻仙镇，很是热闹，不少得到消息的大宗门都派弟子出来。
太一宗、玄月宗还有天剑宗，就连一向低调的丹鼎谷都来了弟子。
毕竟真灵万年难得一见，自十万年前那场异族入侵之后，真灵就渐渐消失不见了。
这一次，消息来自天机阁。
天机阁的天机老人洞眼天机，预测消息从不出错，这一次也不会例外。
云星落刚下了飞舟就看见了天剑宗的弟子。
让她意外的是，这次带队的依然是肖鹤，副队长是青云峰的陆承舟，那只毒蝎子苏芫芫也来了。
看见云星落，苏芫芫眼中迸发出强烈的恨意。

陆承舟却是一脸鄙视，“这云星落修为也没有多大进步嘛，还在筑基期，上次你们怎么被她搞得那么狼狈？”
苏芫芫咬着牙道，“陆师兄有所不知，这云星落狡猾之极，上次她丹田破碎，成了凡人，她就利用黑雾森林的规则让我们犯错，设局坑我们。”
“说到底还是你们废物。”
陆承舟有些不屑，“这一次，看我怎么玩死她。”
“陆师弟，我们这次的任务是寻找真灵，别节外生枝。”
肖鹤提醒道。
陆承舟不屑一顾，“你废物不等于我废物，这次你少说话，一切我来负责。”
云星落并没有理会天剑宗的人，而是坐到边路等候。
黑雾森林有个特点，巳时之前黑雾浓郁，不适合进森林。
巳时之后黑雾开始慢慢散开，到了酉时雾气再起，所以历练的人必须掌握这个规律，不然就会迷失在森林里。
看见云星落一个人，几名散修过来邀约，“道友，可否一起同行？”
云星落想起出发前韩老头说过的话，不可随便相信人。
不过还没等她拒绝，陆承舟就开口了，“诸位，你们眼前的这位是我们天剑宗的弃徒，任何人与她结盟就是与我天剑宗为敌。”
听他一言，许多想结盟的散修都后退了三步。
开玩笑，他们只是散修，怎么敢得罪天剑宗这样的庞然大物。
看到这些散修很听话，陆承舟很满意，他接着道，“诸位，这位弃徒忘恩负义，玷污我们宗门声誉，我天剑宗在此声明，任何人帮我们杀了云星落，将是我们天剑宗的朋友，而且将得到一万块上品灵石的酬劳。”
一万块上品灵石，很多散修眼都红了。
他们别说有一万块上品灵石，很多人就连一万块下品灵石都没有。
很多人就心动了。
content_en:
Yun Xingluo collected the Qiankun Bag and left the Star Reaching Sect, and came to Yunyin Town. He bought some meat buns to satisfy his hunger, and also bought a map of the Black Mist Forest.
At this time, the streets were bustling with people, and many people gathered together, almost all casual cultivators.
Seeing the clouds and stars falling, a middle-aged man wearing a brown bicorn hat came over and said, "Fellow Taoist, do you want to take a flying boat?"
"Can I still take the flying boat?"
Yun Xingluo went out alone for the first time and didn't know this.
"Of course, our flying boat can go to various towns in the Black Mist Forest. This time we are flying to Xunxian Town, will fellow Taoist go?"
"How much?"
"A thousand low-grade spiritual stones. If you want to leave, hurry up. We only run back and forth once a day."
A thousand yuan is a bit expensive, but in a place like the Black Mist Forest, it is very dangerous to use a sword, and you will be attacked by beasts in the sky at any time, so many people choose to take a flying boat.
Most sects have their own flying boats, but casual cultivators do not, so there are many people doing flying boat transportation business in the Black Mist Forest.
Yun Xingluo happily took out a thousand spiritual stones and boarded the flying boat.
It's not far from Yunyin Town to Xunxian Town by flying boat, it only takes half an hour.
At this time, Xunxian Town was very lively, and many major sects who got the news sent their disciples out.
Taiyi Sect, Xuanyue Sect, Tianjian Sect, and even the always low-key Danding Valley all had disciples.
After all, true spirits are rare to see for thousands of years. Since the alien invasion a hundred thousand years ago, true spirits have gradually disappeared.
This time, the news came from Tianji Pavilion.
The old man Tianji in Tianji Pavilion has an eye for secrets and his predictions are never wrong, and this time will be no exception.
Yun Xingluo saw the disciples of Tianjian Sect as soon as he got off the flying boat.
What surprised her was that Xiao He was still leading the team this time, and the deputy captain was Lu Chengzhou from Qingyun Peak. The poisonous scorpion Su Xiangqian also came.
Seeing the clouds and stars falling, Su Xiangqian's eyes burst out with intense hatred.
Lu Chengzhou looked contemptuous, "Yun Xingluo hasn't made much progress in her cultivation. She's still in the foundation building stage. Why were you so embarrassed by her last time?"
Su Qianqian gritted her teeth and said, "Senior Brother Lu doesn't know something. Yun Xingluo is extremely cunning. Last time her Dantian was shattered and she became a mortal, she used the rules of the Black Mist Forest to make us make mistakes and set up a trap to trap us."
"In the end, you are still trash."
Lu Chengzhou was a little disdainful, "This time, let's see how I kill her."
"Junior Brother Lu, our mission this time is to find the true spirit, and don't make any unnecessary mistakes."
Xiao He reminded.
Lu Chengzhou dismissed it, "You are useless and I am useless. Please stop talking this time. I will be responsible for everything."
Yun Xingluo didn't pay attention to the people from Tianjian Sect, but sat on the side and waited.
The black mist forest has a special characteristic. Before Sishi, the black mist was dense and it was not suitable to enter the forest.
After Si hour, the black fog begins to slowly disperse, and at You hour, the fog rises again, so experienced people must master this rule, otherwise they will get lost in the forest.
Seeing Yun Xingluo alone, several casual cultivators came over to invite him, "Fellow Taoist, can we go together?"
Yun Xingluo remembered what Old Man Han said before setting off: Don't trust people casually.
But before she could refuse, Lu Chengzhou spoke, "Everyone, the person in front of you is an abandoned disciple of our Tianjian Sect. Anyone who forms an alliance with her is an enemy of our Tianjian Sect."
After hearing what he said, many casual cultivators who wanted to form an alliance took three steps back.
Just kidding, they are just casual cultivators, how dare they offend such a behemoth as the Tianjian Sect.
Seeing that these casual cultivators were obedient, Lu Chengzhou was very satisfied. He continued, "Everyone, this abandoned disciple is ungrateful and has tarnished the reputation of our sect. We, the Tianjian Sect, hereby declare that anyone who helps us kill Yun Xingluo will be a friend of our Tianjian Sect and will be rewarded with 10,000 high-grade spiritual stones."
Ten thousand high-grade spiritual stones made many casual cultivators blush.
Not to mention they have 10,000 high-grade spiritual stones, many of them don't even have 10,000 low-grade spiritual stones.
a lot ofPeople's hearts are moved.
